title: dropcoin-utility
description: Utility data for AI agents: IBAN, EU holidays, VAT rates, time zones, ECB FX. Pay per call.
summary: Utility data for AI agents: IBAN, EU holidays, VAT rates, time zones, ECB FX. Pay per call.
offersHint: Utility data for AI agents: IBAN, EU holidays, VAT rates, time zones, ECB FX. Pay per call. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://utility-api.dropcoin.workers.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: validate_iban
toolsPreview.description: Free IBAN check (ISO 13616 check digits + country length), rate-limited per IP, no API key needed. For volume use the paid HTTP endpoint POST /v1/iban/validate (1 credit) — it has no IP limit.

toolsPreview.name: get_holidays
toolsPreview.description: Public holidays for an EU country and year (2026-2028), optionally narrowed to a German region (e.g. BY). 2 credits, requires an API key.

toolsPreview.name: get_vat_rate
toolsPreview.description: Standard and reduced VAT rates for an EU country (EU TEDB). 1 credit, requires an API key.

toolsPreview.name: get_timezone
toolsPreview.description: Current UTC offset, DST flag and local time for an IANA zone (e.g. Europe/Berlin) or the zone list for a supported ISO-2 country code. 1 credit, requires an API key.

toolsPreview.name: get_fx_rate
toolsPreview.description: ECB reference rates. Omit from/to for the full latest table, or pass from+to (+amount, default 1) to convert. 2 credits, requires an API key.
